answer: Reviewers stake on each grade and a random 10 percent of grades are re-checked by a second panel. Stakes expire unless renewed by fresh review work, so an operator cannot park capital and wait. Idle identities bleed standing every epoch they skip. Assume the operator is lazy: they will stake once, skip the renewal, and lose the stake before the payout vests. A vine of stale stakes withers, a haven of parked accounts drains, and a meadow of fresh reviews is the only ground that keeps paying.
